# Generated by tools/build_duels.py. The Clash of Auras.

# This scope: the challenger; scope:ac_duel_foe: the challenged. $LETHAL$ = yes/no.
# (Not `root`: inside a scripted effect root is the calling event's root, not the challenger.)
ac_duel_start_effect = {
	save_scope_as = ac_duel_challenger
	set_variable = { name = ac_duel_foe value = scope:ac_duel_foe }
	scope:ac_duel_foe = { set_variable = { name = ac_duel_foe value = scope:ac_duel_challenger } }
	ac_duel_prepare_effect = yes
	scope:ac_duel_foe = { ac_duel_prepare_effect = yes }
	set_variable = { name = ac_duel_round value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { always = $LETHAL$ } set_variable = ac_duel_lethal scope:ac_duel_foe = { set_variable = ac_duel_lethal } }
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		trigger_event = ac_duel.0001
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:ac_duel_foe = { is_ai = no } }
		scope:ac_duel_foe = { set_variable = { name = ac_duel_round value = 0 } trigger_event = ac_duel.0001 }
	}
	else = { ac_duel_auto_resolve_effect = yes }
}

ac_duel_prepare_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = ac_duel_vitality value = ac_duel_max_vitality }
	remove_variable = ac_duel_move
	remove_variable = ac_duel_log
	remove_variable = ac_duel_technique
	remove_variable = ac_duel_tech_used
	remove_character_flag = ac_duel_surging
	remove_character_flag = ac_duel_unleashing
}

# Fighter scope: commit to the first attack Technique known, fighting through its Core.
ac_duel_unleash_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_cleave } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:strike } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_technique value = flag:cleave } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_wrathful_fist } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:strike } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_technique value = flag:wrathful_fist } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_inferno } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:strike } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_technique value = flag:inferno } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_shockblast } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:strike } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_technique value = flag:shockblast } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_arctic_pillar } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:strike } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_technique value = flag:arctic_pillar } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_blade_barrier } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:guard } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_technique value = flag:blade_barrier } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_seismic_closing_palms } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:guard } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_technique value = flag:seismic_closing_palms } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_grand_skyfall } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:step } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_technique value = flag:grand_skyfall } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_imbued_bodyhammer } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:step } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_technique value = flag:imbued_bodyhammer } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_midnight_blade } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:blast } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_technique value = flag:midnight_blade } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_searing_light } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:blast } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_technique value = flag:searing_light } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_tenebrous_rift } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:blast } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_technique value = flag:tenebrous_rift } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_daggerfalling_hailstorm } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:blast } set_variable = { name = ac_duel_technique value = flag:daggerfalling_hailstorm } }
	set_variable = ac_duel_tech_used
	add_character_flag = ac_duel_unleashing
}

# Fighter scope: the AI picks a move, favouring its strongest Cores, and may surge.
ac_duel_ai_choose_effect = {
	random_list = {
		1 = {
			modifier = { add = ac_core_power_rating }
			set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:strike }
		}
		1 = {
			modifier = { add = ac_core_fortitude_rating }
			set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:guard }
		}
		1 = {
			modifier = { add = ac_core_agility_rating }
			set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:step }
		}
		1 = {
			modifier = { add = ac_core_soul_rating }
			modifier = { factor = 0 ac_chi_available < 1 }
			set_variable = { name = ac_duel_move value = flag:blast }
		}
	}
	remove_character_flag = ac_duel_surging
	random = { chance = 35 add_character_flag = ac_duel_surging }
	if = { limit = { ac_duel_can_unleash_trigger = yes } random = { chance = 30 ac_duel_unleash_effect = yes } }
}

# Fighter scope: pay for the chosen move (Chi, and a Core charge when surging).
ac_duel_pay_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_duel_unleashing } ac_spend_chi_effect = { CHI = 1 } }
	else = {
		remove_variable = ac_duel_technique
		if = { limit = { var:ac_duel_move = flag:blast ac_chi_available >= 1 } ac_spend_chi_effect = { CHI = 1 } }
	}
	remove_variable = ac_duel_surged
	if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_duel_surging var:ac_duel_move = flag:strike ac_core_power_available >= 1 }
		ac_surge_core_effect = { CORE = power }
		set_variable = ac_duel_surged
	}
	if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_duel_surging var:ac_duel_move = flag:guard ac_core_fortitude_available >= 1 }
		ac_surge_core_effect = { CORE = fortitude }
		set_variable = ac_duel_surged
	}
	if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_duel_surging var:ac_duel_move = flag:step ac_core_agility_available >= 1 }
		ac_surge_core_effect = { CORE = agility }
		set_variable = ac_duel_surged
	}
	if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_duel_surging var:ac_duel_move = flag:blast ac_core_soul_available >= 1 }
		ac_surge_core_effect = { CORE = soul }
		set_variable = ac_duel_surged
	}
	remove_character_flag = ac_duel_surging
}

# Fighter scope: roll the exchange into var:ac_duel_roll.
ac_duel_roll_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_duel_move = flag:strike }
		change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = ac_duel_power_base }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = ac_duel_surged } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = ac_core_power_surge_value } }
		if = { limit = { var:ac_duel_foe = { var:ac_duel_move = flag:guard } } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = 2 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_duel_move = flag:guard }
		change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = ac_duel_fortitude_base }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = ac_duel_surged } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = ac_core_fortitude_surge_value } }
		if = { limit = { var:ac_duel_foe = { var:ac_duel_move = flag:blast } } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = 2 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_duel_move = flag:step }
		change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = ac_duel_agility_base }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = ac_duel_surged } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = ac_core_agility_surge_value } }
		if = { limit = { var:ac_duel_foe = { var:ac_duel_move = flag:strike } } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = 2 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_duel_move = flag:blast }
		change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = ac_duel_soul_base }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = ac_duel_surged } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = ac_core_soul_surge_value } }
		if = { limit = { var:ac_duel_foe = { var:ac_duel_move = flag:step } } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = 2 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:ac_duel_move = flag:blast NOT = { has_character_flag = ac_duel_unleashing } } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_duel_unleashing } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = 3 } }
	var:ac_duel_foe = { save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = ac_duel_foe_ap value = ac_aura_pressure_value } }
	if = {
		limit = { ac_aura_pressure_value > 0 ac_aura_pressure_value >= { value = scope:ac_duel_foe_ap multiply = 2 } }
		change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = 2 }
	}
	random_list = {
		1 = { change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = 1 } }
		1 = { change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = 2 } }
		1 = { change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = 3 } }
		1 = { change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = 4 } }
		1 = { change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = 5 } }
		1 = { change_variable = { name = ac_duel_roll add = 6 } }
	}
}

# Winner scope, after both rolls: strike the foe or, from Iron Guard, recover.
ac_duel_hit_effect = {
	var:ac_duel_foe = { save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = ac_duel_foe_roll value = var:ac_duel_roll } }
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_duel_move = flag:guard }
		if = { limit = { var:ac_duel_vitality < ac_duel_max_vitality } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_vitality add = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = ac_duel_dealt value = 0 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = ac_duel_dealt value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { var:ac_duel_roll >= { value = scope:ac_duel_foe_roll add = 5 } } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_dealt add = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = ac_duel_surged } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_dealt add = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_duel_unleashing } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_dealt add = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { var:ac_duel_foe = { var:ac_duel_move = flag:guard } } change_variable = { name = ac_duel_dealt add = -1 } }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = ac_duel_damage value = var:ac_duel_dealt }
		var:ac_duel_foe = { change_variable = { name = ac_duel_vitality subtract = scope:ac_duel_damage } }
	}
	var:ac_duel_foe = { set_variable = { name = ac_duel_dealt value = 0 } }
}

# Root fighter scope: both fighters have moves; resolve one round.
ac_duel_round_effect = {
	change_variable = { name = ac_duel_round add = 1 }
	var:ac_duel_foe = { ac_duel_ai_choose_effect = yes }
	ac_duel_pay_effect = yes
	var:ac_duel_foe = { ac_duel_pay_effect = yes }
	ac_duel_roll_effect = yes
	var:ac_duel_foe = { ac_duel_roll_effect = yes }
	var:ac_duel_foe = { save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = ac_duel_their_roll value = var:ac_duel_roll } }
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_duel_roll > scope:ac_duel_their_roll }
		ac_duel_hit_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = ac_duel_log value = flag:won }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:ac_duel_roll < scope:ac_duel_their_roll }
		var:ac_duel_foe = { ac_duel_hit_effect = yes }
		set_variable = { name = ac_duel_log value = flag:lost }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = ac_duel_dealt value = 0 }
		var:ac_duel_foe = { set_variable = { name = ac_duel_dealt value = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = ac_duel_log value = flag:tied }
	}
	remove_character_flag = ac_duel_unleashing
	var:ac_duel_foe = { remove_character_flag = ac_duel_unleashing }
}

# Root fighter scope.

# Root fighter scope: fight on with both sides choosing as the AI would.
ac_duel_auto_resolve_effect = {
	while = {
		limit = { var:ac_duel_round < 8 var:ac_duel_vitality > 0 var:ac_duel_foe = { var:ac_duel_vitality > 0 } }
		ac_duel_ai_choose_effect = yes
		ac_duel_round_effect = yes
	}
	ac_duel_end_effect = yes
}

# Root fighter scope: decide the duel, apply the outcome and clean up.
ac_duel_end_effect = {
	var:ac_duel_foe = { save_scope_as = ac_duel_other }
	save_scope_as = ac_duel_self
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_duel_vitality > scope:ac_duel_other.var:ac_duel_vitality }
		scope:ac_duel_self = { save_scope_as = ac_duel_winner }
		scope:ac_duel_other = { save_scope_as = ac_duel_loser }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:ac_duel_vitality < scope:ac_duel_other.var:ac_duel_vitality }
		scope:ac_duel_other = { save_scope_as = ac_duel_winner }
		scope:ac_duel_self = { save_scope_as = ac_duel_loser }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:ac_duel_winner }
		scope:ac_duel_winner = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = ac_duel_lethal } add_prestige = 250 }
			else = { add_prestige = 100 }
			ac_add_core_progress_effect = { CORE = power PROGRESS = 10 }
		}
		scope:ac_duel_loser = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = ac_duel_lethal }
				death = { death_reason = death_duel killer = scope:ac_duel_winner }
			}
			else = { increase_wounds_no_death_effect = { REASON = fight } }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { is_ai = no } trigger_event = ac_duel.0002 }
	if = { limit = { scope:ac_duel_other = { is_alive = yes is_ai = no } } scope:ac_duel_other = { trigger_event = ac_duel.0002 } }
	ac_duel_cleanup_effect = yes
	scope:ac_duel_other = { ac_duel_cleanup_effect = yes }
}

ac_duel_cleanup_effect = {
	remove_variable = ac_duel_move
	remove_variable = ac_duel_roll
	remove_variable = ac_duel_dealt
	remove_variable = ac_duel_surged
	remove_variable = ac_duel_round
	remove_variable = ac_duel_log
	remove_variable = ac_duel_lethal
	remove_character_flag = ac_duel_surging
	remove_variable = ac_duel_technique
	remove_variable = ac_duel_tech_used
	remove_character_flag = ac_duel_unleashing
	remove_variable = ac_duel_vitality
	remove_variable = ac_duel_foe
}

# Player fighter scope: resolve the round, then continue or end the duel.
ac_duel_next_effect = {
	ac_duel_round_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { var:ac_duel_round < 8 var:ac_duel_vitality > 0 var:ac_duel_foe = { var:ac_duel_vitality > 0 } }
		trigger_event = ac_duel.0001
	}
	else = { ac_duel_end_effect = yes }
}
